ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The ventral surface is dominated by low-intensity (near-black) pixels (~90% coverage) contrasted by localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters (~10% coverage) forming rings and tip mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white annuli (circular rings) are scattered across the central and medial regions of both lobes. Contiguous high-intensity white mottling is concentrated on the distal lateral margins (tips) of both fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A distinct V-shaped median notch is visible with an internal angle of approximately 55 degrees and a vertical depth relative to the lobe peaks of approximately 65 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire boundary. Notable macro-notches (deeper pixel valleys) are visible on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe and the central-upper section of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges of both lobes follow a symmetric concave upward curve from the median notch towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of over 30 distinct white circular pixel rings (annuli) of varying diameters (approx. 5-15 pixels) distributed across the dark ventral field. High-intensity, irregular white clusters are present at the extreme lateral tips, corresponding to calcified body colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several fine, white, multi-directional linear pixel disruptions are visible on the inner medial section of the left lobe, cutting across the dark primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (depigmented rings) across the main body of the fluke; irregular white masses representing active barnacle attachment are visible on the terminal ends of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The density and specific spatial distribution of the circular ring-shaped scars across the dark background provide a unique high-contrast visual fingerprint.
